note: 2026 store signs from Steven's Oct 23 2026 footage; built by tools/stores/signs/sign_2026.gd. Edit y26/parts/<id>.json and run make_signs_2026.py.

signs.ref: IMG_4482 photo (full res, oblique ~35 deg; squared up on the letters' top and base lines); IMG_4483, IMG_4481 (whole word, smaller), IMG_4492 f009 (close oblique, returns)
signs.notes: Red-pink lit channel letters 'AÉROPOSTALE' (bold condensed caps, acute on the E), dark maroon returns. In the footage the letters hang just INSIDE the glass, in the top of the centre opening of a matte-black riveted steel portal (the black header behind them); here they are put on the black fascia, which reads the same from the hall. Font Oswald Bold (OFL) tracked open, matches widths within ~3%. The squaring aspect is inferred from the font fit (only oblique views exist), so letter width +-8%. Size from a person in IMG_4481: caps ~0.42 m, word ~3.2 m. The palm in front hides the bottom of STALE in every view.

signs.ref: IMG_4442 contact-sheet f007 (globe + 'AT&', oblique; squared up), f008 (square-on 'AT&T', globe cut off: letter widths)
signs.notes: The current AT&T mark: blue striped globe (the stripes read as dark gaps cut into its left side; traced, three visible) then 'AT&T' in white heavy geometric sans, both lit faces, on the black metal fascia band over a wide open storefront with grey slate-tile pilasters. Returns look black (they vanish into the band). Letters set in Inter Bold at 0.9 width to match the square-on f008 tile (AT&T is 3.3x its cap height there). The squared reference leans slightly (letters rise to the right); the 'T' is off its right edge. Cap height ~0.5 m from the ~1.2 m band; globe ~0.75 m.

signs.ref: IMG_4442 f009 (oblique from the left, letters ~50 px), IMG_4440 f031 (far)
signs.notes: Black dry-brush script 'Avant-Garde' (with a few paint flecks, too small to build) on a brushed / diamond-plate aluminium panel hung in the storefront over the entry, below the plain cream mall bulkhead; the front itself is dark rusty steel framing with expanded-metal mesh panels. Unlit. Traced from a soft oblique view (letters ~50 px tall), so the stroke detail is approximate: 'vant' and 'arde' merge into blobs where the blur joins them. Letters read as thin flat-cut black (a slight shadow shows depth). Size from the ~2.2 m door below: panel about 2.7 x 0.9 m (guess).

signs.ref: IMG_4440 f009 (near square-on, letters ~125 px; squared up on the gingham surround, whose checks are square: aspect 5:1); f008-f010
signs.notes: Traced from the lit faces (they threshold cleanly). White internally lit channel letters, the brand's current sans wordmark 'Bath & Body Works', mounted straight on the store's blue/white gingham-check tile surround (navy, mid blue, pale grey-blue and white 6-7 in checks round the whole opening). The builder has no patterned fascia, so the fascia is the gingham's average blue; a gingham texture would be needed to match. Size from the checks (~2.6 mm/px): cap height ~0.32 m, 3.67 m long. A small duplicate 'Bath & Body Works' sign sits on the return wall (f012) and a blade sign down the hall; not modelled here.

signs.ref: IMG_4439 f029 (oblique from the right, squared up on the fascia panel, aspect 3.4:1); f028, f030
signs.notes: Traced. Boost's current logo as lit push-through faces on one black contour-cut backer (the 'contour' part, ~9 cm deep, standing off the panel): the orange bolt/arrow mark with its black slit, white lowercase 'boost', smaller white 'mobile' (the tiny TM is dropped). Letters lit (white faces read bluish, orange glows) with no light on the wall. Mounted on the light warm-grey fascia panel. Size from the opening and panel (~2.8 mm/px), +-15%.

signs.ref: IMG_4439 f026 (oblique from below-right, squared up on the fascia panel, aspect 3.1:1); f025
signs.notes: Lit channel letters with black returns on the cream fascia panel: a red rounded-blob icon holding a white phone (the phone's thin dark outline is not modelled), red 'Cell' (traced), then white 'Xpert' with an oversized X that drops below the baseline. 'Xpert' is set in Poppins Bold (condensed and tightened to the frame) because a palm in front of the store hides the bottoms of 'ert'; X and 'pert' are separate parts so the big X keeps its size. Aspect of the squared-up panel and the 1.2 m panel height are estimates (+-12%).

signs.ref: IMG_4439 f033 (near square-on, letters ~115 px; squared up on the black band's corners, aspect 6.3:1); f031-f032
signs.notes: Traced. Thin flat gold (brushed brass-look) cut letters in a condensed roman serif, 'FIRE HAUS 3.0', unlit, set LEFT of centre on a full-width black band (the backer) between cream travertine strips, with a black crown moulding above (not modelled). Serifs are softened by the ~110 px trace. Size from the 3.0 m opening (~2.8 mm/px): band ~4.6 x 0.73 m, caps ~0.33 m.

signs.ref: IMG_4440 contact-sheet f007 (only view: oblique from below, 'Foot Lock' in frame, the 'er' cut off), f006
signs.notes: Seen only in the contact-sheet tile IMG_4440 f007 (the signs/ full-res file named f007 shows the corridor, not the sign), oblique from below with 'Foot Lock' in frame. Red-face lit channel letters, light grey/silver returns about 12 cm deep, on a brushed stainless/grey metal fascia band over a full-glass front. Mixed case, very heavy, slightly italic, large x-height: set in Inter Black sheared 0.12. The view is foreshortened ~2x horizontally, so the letters' true width can't be read off the frame: the width is the font's natural width, and the check box is stretched to the partial view (letter shapes and weights compare, not the overall width). No stripe/referee logo seen (it may be off frame to the right). Cap height 0.55 m is a guess from the fascia band.

signs.ref: IMG_4443 f009 (square-on, letters ~150 px; right end cut at the period), sheet f009 (panel ends just after 'inc.')
signs.notes: Traced. Green-faced letters with navy returns and a navy trim line, unlit as far as the frame shows (no light on the panel), lowercase rounded 'games, inc.' plus the green alien mascot waving at left, overhanging the white panel at top and bottom. Mascot eyes/pupils are thin flat overlays on its face (dz). The real panel is a raised white panel inside a lighter grey recessed panel framed by mustard 12-in tiles (the fascia colour here is the grey panel; the ochre tile surround is not expressible). The period was cut by the frame edge and redrawn as a dot the size of the i's dot. Size from the 12-in fascia tiles (~1.95 mm/px).

signs.ref: IMG_4478 photo (full res, from below-left; squared up on the steel panel's four corners, aspect 1.75:1 from the perspective); IMG_4477 (oblique, far)
signs.notes: Brushed-stainless rectangular panel (box sign, ~12 cm deep, dark side) hung on the white fascia over the entry, set back under the bulkhead. Red lit 'GNC' logo, a thin tapering white-blue rule, and 'Live Well.' in a white serif, all lit push-through faces (read pale ice-blue in the photo: white LEDs). All three traced from the full-res photo. Panel size from the 3.0 m opening: ~1.5 x 0.88 m (+-10%); aspect of the panel from perspective, +-5%.

signs.ref: IMG_4440 contact-sheet f030 ('-5' close, squared up on the 5), f021 and IMG_4442 f009 (whole word, very oblique / far)
signs.notes: Lowercase 'hi-5' in lime-green flat-cut acrylic (about 3 cm, glossy, unlit) on the light warm-grey fascia band of a candy/snack shop (black storefront, Red Bull and candy inside). Only the '-5' is seen close (sheet f030): a condensed squared 5 with a straight stem, square bowl and up-turned tail, matched by Saira Extra Condensed Bold; 'hi' is only seen edge-on (f021) and far (4442 f009) as two narrow uprights, so its letterforms are the font's. The check box is fitted on the 5 only (the 'hi' falls off the left of the reference). Cap height ~0.55 m guessed from the band; the word is small, about 1 m wide.

signs.ref: IMG_4484 f022 (mall side, oblique, squared up on the red band's edges; the final Y is off the frame edge), f019/f020 (whole word, far), f026 (HYPE close)
signs.notes: Mall-side sign: polished chrome/silver flat-cut letters (mirror faces: they show the ceiling lights' streaks; the small 'RACE TRACK' reads dark only because it mirrors the dark windows opposite) on the matte red painted band (~1.5 m tall) that runs the whole front, unlit. 'HYPERVELOCITY' traced from f022 squared up on the band's top and bottom edges (the horizontal scale of that squaring is judged from the letter shapes, +-10%); the last Y is off the frame edge in every close frame, so it is a copy of the Y in HYPER placed at the same letter spacing (f019/f020 confirm the word ends in Y). 'RACE TRACK' set in Krona One (wide geometric sans, condensed to fit), centred. Size from the 1.5 m band: word ~4.26 m wide, caps ~0.39 m. The exterior signs (cream channel letters, red RACE TRACK) are a different sign, not this spec.

signs.ref: IMG_4440 f020 (near square-on, close; used unwarped), f016-f019 oblique
signs.notes: Journeys' 2020s compass logo: a big pale-grey oval panel (deckled edge, faint dashed 'route' lines printed on it, black 15 cm return) mounted TILTED about 25-30 deg (rising to the right) over the entry, on a purple fascia with a lime-green paint-splash mural. The oval's tilt is real (the letters stand upright in a near-frontal frame), and the backer can't be rotated, so the oval is a traced flat part (an ellipse fitted to its edge). 'Journeys' is hand-drawn faux-neon: pale cyan-white lit tubes (channel, lit, small cyan glow), traced from the bright cores; the overlapping strokes of O-U-R-N merge into one shape (they cross on the real sign too). Compass marks traced as their own parts: two orange chevrons (left of J, after the N), two yellow arrows (above and below the J), a green globe in the O. Dashed route lines not modelled (printed, too faint). Size: oval about 2.4 x 1.2 m (guess, from the 3 m door opening); it hangs below the fascia band (mount_y -0.2).

signs.ref: IMG_4408 f037 (square-on, squared up), f010 (oblique letter/depth detail)
signs.notes: Black flat-cut letters (~5 cm deep, glossy black faces) on the white tiled portal wall of the old Sears mall entrance, unlit; flanked by lantern sconces (not part of the sign). 'Lynn's' script traced from f037 (palm fronds cross the far left of the L's swash, so its very left tip is a best guess). 'INTERIORS' is a bold Roman serif set in Liberation Serif Bold condensed to fit (the real O is a little rounder); the thin rule above it is a separate flat bar. Size from the 3.0 m opening: ~2.7 m wide, script ~1.2 m tall, caps ~0.29 m.

signs.ref: IMG_4484 f006 (fascia sign, oblique, squared up on the fascia panel's mouldings); contact-sheet f021 (same logo as window vinyl, large)
signs.notes: Fascia sign over the black spiral-rod grille: 'Neek' in sky-blue flat-cut letters (bold condensed sans, leaning slightly forward; Fjalla One sheared 0.12 matches the shapes), a small gold '&' and a gold monoline script 'Co.' (thin cut metal/acrylic, gold-painted), all unlit on the white crown-moulded fascia panel. f006 is oblique and soft: squared up on the panel mouldings, horizontal scale judged from the letters (the window vinyl of the same logo in contact-sheet f021 agrees), +-15%. 'Co.' redrawn by hand as a centre-line stroke over the squared-up frame (a colour mask of the thin gold stroke was too ragged); '&' set in Liberation Serif Bold (too small to read its form). Size: ~2.0 m wide, N ~0.55 m tall, from a ~0.8 m fascia panel (guess).

signs.ref: IMG_4469 photo (full res, square-on; read upright as stored; squared up on the pink panel's corners, aspect 5.74:1); IMG_4438 f018-f019 (square-on, medium)
signs.notes: Raspberry-pink rectangular panel over the entry (in the cream classical panelled facade, which is the storefront, not the sign). Collegiate slab 'PINK': lit hot-pink faces with a thin white edge (trim) sitting on a gold mirror-finish outline layer (flat part under the faces, dz); a faint pink glow round the letters. 'life is' / 'is life' in a white single-line script (vinyl), tiny 'VICTORIA'S SECRET' (vinyl, Cinzel) under PINK. PINK, outline and script traced from the full-res photo; tagline is a font. Size from the shutter opening below (~2.7 m tall): panel ~3.4 x 0.59 m, +-12%. Not built: a second smaller pink panel with the white PINK dog to the right (over the poster box).

signs.ref: IMG_4459 f014 (right-bay sign, near square-on, 'Impressive P' in frame, letters ~30 px), sheet f013 (both bays: the same sign over each glass bay)
signs.notes: White mixed-case grotesque 'Impressive Prints' (Helvetica-like, semibold, large x-height) as thin flat-cut letters, unlit, on the dark taupe-brown storefront fascia band that runs over two wide glass bays; the same sign appears on both bays (left one behind the palm in f014). Set in Inter SemiBold as two words (the real word space is wide, ~0.75 cap), which matches the word width (7.2x cap for 'Impressive'). 'Prints' is cut off in the sharp frame, read from sheet f013. The game has one sign per store, so only one copy is built. Cap height ~0.3 m (letters ~1/3 of the band).

signs.ref: IMG_4483 photo (square-on, full res; squared up on the right beadboard panel, aspect 3.85:1 from camera geometry and groove count); IMG_4482, IMG_4492 f003 (oblique, depth/returns)
signs.notes: Connected royal-blue script 'Rainbow' (one can for R-a-i-n-b-o-w plus the i dot), lit blue acrylic faces, dark navy/charcoal returns about 10 cm deep, mounted straight on the white vertical-beadboard fascia (painted panel mouldings; the beadboard and its panel frames are part of the storefront, not the sign). Traced from the full-res photo; shape is certain. Size from the beadboard groove pitch (assumed 10 cm): about 2.8 m x 0.70 m, +-15%. No glow on the wall in daylight-lit mall, so none given.

signs.ref: IMG_4407 f003 (mall side, square-on, squared up on the garage-door opening); f006
signs.notes: Mall-side sign (the exterior parapet sign is a separate, later job). Flat-cut red PVC/acrylic letters (~2.5 cm, matte, unlit) 'THE RED' + 'SEAL' in a condensed rounded-corner display sans, the red scalloped wax-seal disc between them with its white 'R' and swirl rings as a thin raised layer on the disc (monogram, dz), and 'PIZZERIA & BAR' in small black spaced caps below; stud-mounted straight onto the white knock-down stucco above the black folding-glass opening. All traced from f003 squared up on the opening (seal checked round). The real seal's white is pale pink-white. Size from a ~4.5 m opening: ~2.58 m wide, cap height ~0.39 m, seal ~0.6 m.

signs.ref: IMG_4439 f034 (oblique; storefront squared up on the blue surround, aspect ~2.6:1 assumed); f033
signs.notes: No fascia sign in the footage. The whole storefront is a bright-blue painted box surround with a white inner trim round a full-height glass front; the only 'Rhea Lana's' lettering is a white script LED/neon sign INSIDE on the pink back wall (seen through the glass, too small and blurred to trace) and red/pink posters taped in the windows. Modelled as no letters: just the blue band above the glass with its white trim (backer), so the unit reads right. If a name sign is wanted, the likely look is the white Rhea Lana's script (as on the interior neon) as vinyl on this blue band, but that is not what the mall shows.

signs.ref: Letterforms: IMG_4476 photo (blade sign, full res, squared up on its square face). Layout/colour of the fascia sign: IMG_4479 (top-right corner, blurred, oblique) and IMG_4477 (far right, small).
signs.notes: Fascia over the entry (on the white panel front): one line 'SHOE DEPT. ENCORE', black-faced reverse-lit letters with a cool blue-white halo on the wall (IMG_4479, IMG_4477; both blurred/oblique/small, so the fascia letters were set from the wordmark on the projecting blade sign in IMG_4476, which is sharp: heavy condensed caps 'SHOE DEPT.' = Anton, thin condensed 'ENCORE' = Oswald Light, ENCORE ~6% taller). The check image shows the blade's stacked layout; the fascia is inline. Whether the fascia has a thin rule or a separator between DEPT. and ENCORE can't be read. Size guessed from the 3 m entry: caps ~0.38 m, ~3.3 m long. Not built (format has one sign per store): the black 0.75 m square blade box projecting from the wall west of the windows, white-lit 'SHOE DEPT.' / rule / 'ENCORE'.

signs.ref: IMG_4440 f001 (closest, oblique from left; squared up on the roll-shutter panel), IMG_4439 f035
signs.notes: Not a channel-letter sign: Spencer's 2026 front is a faux red-brick storefront with a rusty steel-angle frame; the 'sign' is a spray-painted graffiti 'Spencer's' on the half-raised black roll-down security shutter over the entry, lit only by the mall lights. Backer = the visible shutter (about 2.3 x 1.0 m, guessed from the brick courses). The shutter's background is a red/pink/blue/purple spray-paint wash with horizontal slat lines: the builder takes one backer colour, so it is the median purple (#8c5f96); a printed backer texture would be truer (the format can't take one). Letters: two traced vinyl layers, the black outline/drop-shadow silhouette (also covers the thin white rim) and the orange fill on top (deeper by 3 mm so it sits in front). Orange corrected from the warm frame. The band above is the plain cream mall wall; the piers either side are faux brick.

signs.ref: IMG_4461 f045 (steep oblique from below-left, squared up on the blue face's corners, aspect 3.8:1 assumed); sheet f043-f044
signs.notes: Font (the view is a steep, motion-blurred oblique; too soft to trace). A sky-blue box cabinet under the bulkhead over the entry. 'TREASURE ISLAND' in chunky cartoon caps (Lilita One is close: the I has bar serifs as on the sign): white faces with a thin black outline and deep yellow-gold returns (seen from below); 'PUTT PUTT GOLF' in small dark navy wide caps. Unlit as far as the frame shows. Cabinet aspect (3.8:1) and 1.0 m height are estimates (+-15%).

signs.ref: IMG_4474 photo (full res, square-ish; squared up on the nickel portal's opening, aspect 1.6:1 from the camera geometry, then levelled 1.15 deg); IMG_4438 f016-f017 (square-on, medium)
signs.notes: Polished nickel/champagne serif caps, widely spaced, initial V and S about 1.2x the rest (the VS wordmark; built as four parts because the font's small caps are composite glyphs the builder can't read), reverse-lit: warm white halo on the wall below/behind. On the blush-pink glossy panel fascia above a brushed-nickel picture-frame portal. Font Cinzel Bold (OFL), the nearest free Trajan-like face; the real VS face has slightly wider S/C and finer serifs. Size from the portal opening taken as 3.0 m tall: big caps ~0.275 m, word ~4.3 m (+-10%). A second, smaller unlit 'VICTORIA'S / SECRET' on the return wall (IMG_4475) is not built.

signs.ref: IMG_4441 f006 (near square-on from below, letters ~170 px); IMG_4441 f004-f005
signs.notes: Traced. A flat matte-black panel (about 8 x 4.5 ft, a few cm thick) hung on the cream soffit over the food-court counter, with glossy yellow cut letters (unlit: no light on the panel) in the brand's spiky italic display face, two lines. Panel aspect from perspective (1.75:1, +-8%); size estimated against the counter and ceiling grid.
